title: Knowledge Entry Frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of each knowledge entry markdown file under knowledge/<pack>/{skills,agents,rules,prompts}/<name>.md.

id.description: Neutral entry id in the form <pack>.<kind>.<name>.

name.description: Identifier passed to the target tool. Conventionally <pack>-<entry-name>.

tools.description: Per-target build directives. Keys are target tool names (claude, codex, gemini, ...).

uses_skills.description: Dependent skill ids. Only meaningful when kind is agent.

enabled.description: If true, this entry is built for the target. If omitted, falls back to manifest.default_tools.

frontmatter.description: Target-specific frontmatter fields merged into the generated file's frontmatter.
